Name: TSQL_CONVERSION_CORE
Feature: CAST(expr AS type), CONVERT(type, expr [, style]), TRY_CAST(expr AS type), TRY_CONVERT(type, expr [, style]), PARSE(string AS type [USING culture]), TRY_PARSE(string AS type [USING culture]), ISNULL(expr, replacement), COALESCE(expr1, expr2, ...)
Description: Core T-SQL conversion and NULL-handling behavior differences.
CONVERT supports style codes for date/time and character formatting (T-SQL specific).
TRY_CAST and TRY_CONVERT return NULL on failure, which is useful in fuzzing pipelines to avoid hard stop.
PARSE/TRY_PARSE are culture-aware but typically slower due to CLR involvement.
ISNULL return type follows first argument, while COALESCE follows type precedence rules.
EffectiveSQLs: SELECT TRY_CAST(col AS datetime2) FROM dbo.t;
